report.explanation: All checkout observations returned 200 with durations 62-344ms; logs show no errors and metrics show zero 502s. The single 344ms sample is a mild outlier, not a sustained latency fault. No evidence supports any taxonomy cause (no 500s, no pool exhaustion, no redis timeout, no memory leak, no deployment facts). Insufficient basis to name a bounded root cause; hand off.
missing_evidence: Sustained latency or error-rate baseline for /v1/checkout over a longer window to confirm whether 344ms is anomalous
Downstream service (order, inventory, payment, postgres, redis) latency/error telemetry to localize any slow hop
Deployment or configuration change records correlated with the observation window
Resource metrics (CPU, memory, connection pool saturation) for gateway and downstream services
